records.h1: Your research already has a home.
records.bodyText: ContributeYour research already has a home.Connect it to a wider network. Start with the GitHub projects and organizations you already use.Share a public link01Start with a linkA public repository or organization URL is enough to propose a source. No special file, AIPOCH account or client is required.02Review what you shareCheck the source and the exact description. Keep private research data and credentials in your own environment.03Continue on GitHubSubmit the prepared issue on GitHub. The directory review happens there, with a traceable discussion.A place for existing organizationsChoose what represents your work.An organization link starts a candidate review. Select the repositories you want considered; the whole organization is not enrolled automatically.Directory inclusion, a maintainer acknowledgement, and authority to curate an organization each have their own scope and evidence.Propose an organizationKeep collaboration at the source.Discuss methods and code with the original project. Bring directory corrections, source suggestions and evidence records to AIPOCH.Read the contribution guideOpen-Science is an optional way to continue research locally. You can browse and contribute public GitHub sources without installing it.
